ayahs.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ امْرَأَتُ عِمْرَانَ رَبِّ إِنِّي نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِي بَطْنِي مُحَرَّرًا
ayahs.translation_en: When the wife of Imran said, 'My Lord, indeed I have pledged to You what is in my womb, consecrated.'

ayahs.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّي وَضَعْتُهَا أُنثَىٰ وَاللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ
ayahs.translation_en: But when she delivered her, she said, 'My Lord, I have delivered a female.' And Allah was most knowing of what she delivered.

ayahs.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا
ayahs.translation_en: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner.

ayahs.arabic: وَاذْكُرْ فِي الْكِتَابِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ انتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًا شَرْقِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: And mention, in the Book, Maryam, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.

ayahs.arabic: فَاتَّخَذَتْ مِن دُونِهِمْ حِجَابًا فَأَرْسَلْنَا إِلَيْهَا رُوحَنَا فَتَمَثَّلَ لَهَا بَشَرًا سَوِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel, and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَا أَنَا رَسُولُ رَبِّكِ لِأَهَبَ لَكِ غُلَامًا زَكِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'I am only a messenger of your Lord to give you a pure boy.'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَتْ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَامٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِي بَشَرٌ وَلَمْ أَكُ بَغِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: She said, 'How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ هُوَ عَلَيَّ هَيِّنٌ
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Thus it will be; your Lord says, It is easy for Me.'
So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.

ayahs.arabic: فَأَجَاءَهَا الْمَخَاضُ إِلَىٰ جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ قَالَتْ يَا لَيْتَنِي مِتُّ قَبْلَ هَٰذَا
ayahs.translation_en: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, 'Oh, I wish I had died before this.'

ayahs.arabic: فَنَادَاهَا مِن تَحْتِهَا أَلَّا تَحْزَنِي قَدْ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحْتَكِ سَرِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: But he called her from below her, 'Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.'

ayahs.arabic: وَهُزِّي إِلَيْكِ بِجِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ تُسَاقِطْ عَلَيْكِ رُطَبًا جَنِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: 'And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.'

ayahs.arabic: فَأَتَتْ بِهِ قَوْمَهَا تَحْمِلُهُ ۖ قَالُوا يَا مَرْيَمُ لَقَدْ جِئْتِ شَيْئًا فَرِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, 'O Maryam, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.'

ayahs.arabic: فَأَشَارَتْ إِلَيْهِ ۖ قَالُوا كَيْفَ نُكَلِّمُ مَن كَانَ فِي الْمَهْدِ صَبِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: So she pointed to him. They said, 'How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?'

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ إِنِّي عَبْدُ اللَّهِ آتَانِيَ الْكِتَابَ وَجَعَلَنِي نَبِيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: He said, 'Indeed, I am the servant of Allah. He has given me the Scripture and made me a prophet.'

ayahs.arabic: وَالسَّلَامُ عَلَيَّ يَوْمَ وُلِدتُّ وَيَوْمَ أَمُوتُ وَيَوْمَ أُبْعَثُ حَيًّا
ayahs.translation_en: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive.
